name: vimentin

function.text: VIM encodes vimentin. Annotated molecular activities include molecular adaptor activity and structural constituent of cytoskeleton. It participates in intermediate filament organization and regulation of mRNA stability.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to cataract 30 (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include YAP1::KMT2A-rearranged sarcoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; strong GenCC assertion from Labcorp Genetics (formerly Invitae). Allele-specific mechanism requires review.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Educational atlas reports rearrangement context; exact allele and disease applicability require review.
